events.address: Yoseka Land, 58 West St, Brooklyn, NY 11222
events.what_it_is: TRAVELER’S COMPANY’s 20th-anniversary caravan at Yoseka Land, with the Stamp Caravan, a history gallery, community gathering, and limited-edition/event-exclusive stationery for sale.
events.what_is_free: Admission to the Sept. 18–20 public pop-up is free; visitors can browse the anniversary exhibition and Stamp Caravan. Merchandise is sold separately.
events.caveats: Do not confuse the free Sept. 18–20 public pop-up with the Sept. 11–12 ticketed workshop/GA sessions, which are sold out. Anniversary merchandise is limited and may sell out.
events.practical_notes: Free public admission Sept. 18–20, 10 AM–7 PM daily at Yoseka Land. No ticket is required for these free-admission days.

events.what_it_is: DedCool’s first café-and-retail pop-up celebrating Mocha Magic, with café-style drinks, fragrance sampling, exclusive merchandise and gifts.
events.what_is_free: Fragrance sampling and a special gift for the first 50 guests in line each day; the host also advertises café drinks and gifts as part of the activation. Retail merchandise is available for purchase.
events.caveats: The host Partiful provides an RSVP/guest-list action, but published event information describes the pop-up as open daily and the giveaway as first-50-in-line. Treat RSVP as optional rather than guaranteed admission. Gifts are while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: Sept. 18–20, 9 AM–6 PM daily. If the first-50 gift matters, arrive early; line/capacity conditions may apply.
